entities.justification: Appears in the text as the plaintiff: 'Nobilis et Honestus Albertus Slaszinski incola Suburbij Haliciensis'.
Matches known entity LOC-0012: Halych Suburb, designated as the residence of Albertus Slaszinski.
Matches known entity PER-0612: Bartholomaeus Łopuszyński, the defendant in the wound complaint.
Matches known entity Lwów, occurring in the adjectival form 'Suburbanum Leopoliensem'.
The issuing authority of the record ('Nos etiam reprotestati sumus... Actis inseri fecimus') and target of the protest ('contra officium').
Commissioner or official before whom the witnesses were examined: 'coram Zellerem et Bartholomaeum Bebeł'.
Examiner/commissioner alongside Zeller: 'coram Zellerem et Bartholomaeum Bebeł se examinari'.
Corresponds to the known witness Simonowa (Anna Simonowa, PER-0026), giving testimony for Slaczynski.
